summary: Become a Certified Artificial Intelligence Manager and unlock new career opportunities. Master AI strategies and lead your team to success in the tech industry.
audienceIntro: This training course is intended for: This course is designed for: AI Project Managers: Responsible for planning and delivering AI initiatives, strengthening governance skills, and communicating outcomes. Business Leaders & Program Directors: Overseeing AI initiatives across teams, ensuring technology investments support business objectives. Risk, Compliance, & Governance Officers: Reviewing AI use cases, conducting AI risk assessments, and ensuring ethical compliance. Team Leaders & Managers: Working with vendors and internal teams to ensure AI solutions deliver tangible, measurable value. IT Managers & Consultants: Moving into AI leadership roles, requiring comprehensive understanding of AI strategy and governance. Digital Transformation Professionals: Seeking to integrate AI effectively into organizational processes and drive innovation. Data Scientists & Analysts: Aiming to broaden their expertise into AI governance, project management, and strategic alignment. Chief Operating Officers (COOs): Overseeing operational efficiency and integrating AI for process optimization. Legal & Regulatory Affairs Specialists: Focusing on AI policy development, data privacy, and ethical AI frameworks. Product Owners: Defining and managing AI-powered products, ensuring alignment with business value and user needs.
prerequisites: There are no formal prerequisites for this training course. A general familiarity with business processes, data, or digital tools is helpful but not required.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
